snippet.title: Command Deck - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
We are very happy to announce our studio's first game: Command Deck. 
It’s a sci-fi roguelike deckbuilder where you explore the galaxy, face hostile aliens, and upgrade your ship! 🚀

✨ Wishlist On Steam Now! ✨

Early Access Coming Summer 2025
